Nos atendió Martin y no de la mejor manera, no solo eso, sino que no nos quiso cargar combustible por que el tanque de el auto que manejaba esta del otro lado del surtidor ( siendo que es un auto chico y cosa que nunca antes me paso en ninguna estación donde fui en años ) ademas faltaba personal, la estación estaba llena y solo dos playeros atendiendo.

(Translated by Google)
Martin served us, and not in the best way. Not only that, but he refused to fill our tank because the tank of the car he was driving was on the other side of the pump (even though it's a small car, something that has never happened to me at any station I've been to in years). In addition, there was a lack of staff; the station was full and there were only two attendants working.
